Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Electromagnetic Sensing for High-Temperature Microstructural Evolution
  • Host Institution: University of Warwick
  • Department: WMG - Advanced Steel Research Centre (ASRC)
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded (UK students)
  • Stipend: UKRI rate
  • Eligibility: UK Students only
  • Application Deadline: 25 September 2026

Project Description

This PhD redefines electromagnetic sensing by moving beyond magnetic permeability-dominated approaches to establish a conductivity-driven eddy-current framework for tracking microstructural evolution at high temperature. The project addresses a fundamental challenge in electromagnetic sensing: how to quantitatively link electrical conductivity-dominated eddy current responses to microstructural evolution during high-temperature processing. The project includes design and optimisation of kHz–MHz eddy current sensors suitable for high-temperature environments.

How to Apply

Apply via the relevant Engineering/Materials PhD course.
